topics.purpose: Define & as the explicit Routine invocation control that resolves an inert #R Routine definition and dispatches it through the normal bounded Runtime Routine/command path.

semantics.resolve_rule: & resolves an explicit Routine identity from the canonical Routine registry.
semantics.inert_rule: The #R definition remains inert until & or another explicit canonical run operation invokes it.
semantics.dispatch_rule: Routine steps resolve commands/operations through normal registries and dispatcher.
semantics.argument_rule: Invocation arguments are validated against the Routine's declared input semantics.
semantics.cycle_rule: Routine recursion/cycles and chain depth follow Runtime Routine bounds.
semantics.authority_rule: Possessing/reading a Routine definition does not grant run authority.

invariants.rule: Command parsing, namespace resolution and execution remain explicit; namespace grouping never silently becomes executable behavior.
